11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

15007|a69352bd.name: Sir Malory Wheeler
15007|a69352bd.text: Look around you $c.  You are in rare company to be certain, yet still I think you need to prove yourself.  Hmm, perhaps I shall allow you to aid us in our cause at Arathi Basin.  Would you like that?

15197|c0048786.name: Darkcaller Yanka
15197|c0048786.text:
Welcome to the Wickerman Festival, $c!

On the observance of Hallow's End, the Forsaken burn a wickerman in honor of this, the most revered of occasions.  It was on this day that the Banshee Queen herself delivered us from the clutches of the Lich King and the Scourge.  We have remained free ever since.  Those who would have seen us fall are repayed in full... with vengeance!

The burning of the Wickerman begins at 8:00 PM!

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

263646|fb408f08.name: Rugbul Boomfirst
263646|fb408f08.text: Well, well... are you ready to fight for the Horde in Darkspear Islands?

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

2804|cda4c0c1.name: Kurden Bloodclaw
2804|cda4c0c1.text: Are you here to fight for us at Warsong Gulch?  Lok'tar Ogar $c!

4568|8fca8484.name: Anastasia Hartwell
4568|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4568|a9a4b6a0.name: Anastasia Hartwell
4568|a9a4b6a0.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead $c trainer, and you're a $c.

4591|43457c57.name: Mary Edras
4591|43457c57.text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5624|046ba7ad.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|046ba7ad.text: Think him in Royal Quarter. Kurden Bloodclaw is little $r.

5624|f669426b.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|f669426b.text: Us know her good.  She Mary Edras at inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

5958|6e89a35a.name: Thuul
5958|6e89a35a.text: As a $c, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

1657-accept.name: Darkcaller Yanka
1657-accept.text:
Celebrate Hallow's End in style... by bringing grief to our enemies in Southshore!

Take one of these specially crafted stink bombs.  It is filled with an odiferous funk that no human - or any weak-willed beast for that matter - can stand to smell.  You'll need to throw it right in the heart of Southshore for it to do its job, so be prepared for a fight against the Alliance!

When you've completed this task... this tribute to our liberation, return to me!
1657-accept.title: Stinking Up Southshore

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

8322-accept.name: Darkcaller Yanka
8322-accept.text:
The humans of Southshore love their ale, and as such they prize the ale served at the Southshore Inn.  With the chaos of Hallow's End now upon them, we can use it to ruin their latest batch of beverages for weeks - if not months to come!

Take these rotten eggs and place them in the main brew keg inside the Southshore Inn.  Your presence alone will cause strife, so be prepared to defend yourself!

Once you've given Southshore a taste they'll not soon forget, return to me here at the festival!
8322-accept.title: Rotten Eggs

96988-complete.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-complete.text:
Cracked. Cracked. CRACKED.

I can't make use of any of these! I said disable the sentries, not obliterate them! How dangerous could they have been?

My dreams of magus abominations are at a standstill. For now.
96988-complete.title: Source of Power

96988-progress.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-progress.text: The value in these cores is that they are powerful. The downside is that means the constructs are powerful. Good luck.
96988-progress.title: Source of Power

98887-complete.name: Horde Warbringer
98887-complete.text:
The sands of the Darkspear Islands are awash with the blood of the Alliance you've killed. Well done, $N.

For the Horde!
98887-complete.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98887-progress.name: Horde Warbringer
98887-progress.text: What news from the Darkspear Islands, $N?
98887-progress.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
